header.lead: Credentials and certificates issued to you — each certificate has a unique "verification code" that external authorities can use to verify its authenticity. Certificates are issued by the university and are immutable after issuance (they can only be revoked).
header.title: Certificates and Credentials

help.body: Your documents and certificates are gathered here; each certificate has a unique "verification code" that any external authority can use to check its authenticity. To verify a certificate, enter its code in the "Verify authenticity" box.
help.registrarExtra: As a registrar, you can issue a new document for a user using "Issue certificate" or "Revoke" an existing certificate.
help.title: Certificates and Credentials Guide

issue.errTitle: Enter the certificate title (at least 2 characters).
issue.expertiseHelp: The card is valid for one year from the date of issue, automatically set by the system. Issuance is not possible without the holder's profile picture — photo-less cards will not be printed.
issue.holderHelper: The certificate will be issued for this user; users cannot issue certificates themselves.
issue.latinNameHelp: As written in the passport. Without it, the English version of the diploma will not be issued — the system does not generate the Latin name automatically.
issue.title: Issue Certificate
issue.titlePlaceholder: e.g., Data Structures Course Completion Certificate

list.emptyFiltered: No certificates found matching this filter.
list.emptyNone: No certificates have been issued to you yet. Certificates are issued by the university.

profile.activeCount: {count, plural, one {# active certificate} other {# active certificates}}

public.lead: Enter the verification code printed on the diploma, certificate, or specialty card to check its status directly from the university registry. No login or registration is required for this.
public.loginHint: By logging in, the certificate holder can view their complete file and the printable version.
public.note1: This page only displays the status of the document and its public fields; no other personal information of the holder is disclosed.
public.note2: The verification result has three states: valid, expired, or revoked.
public.note3: If no document is found, enter the code exactly as printed on the document.
public.title: Verify Document Authenticity

result.signatureInvalid: Warning: The signature associated with this code is invalid — the URL may have been tampered with. The information above was read directly from the registry.
result.signatureValid: The digital signature accompanying the code has been verified.

revoke.body: Are you sure you want to revoke "{title}"? The certificate status will change to "Revoked" and this status will be shown in future verifications. This action is not a deletion and the certificate will not be removed.
revoke.reasonPlaceholder: e.g., Issued by mistake / Replaced with a new version
revoke.title: Revoke certificate

verify.lead: Enter the verification code printed on the certificate to check its validity.
verify.notFound: No credential with this code is registered in the system. Enter the code exactly as printed on the document.
verify.rateLimited: Too many verification requests; please try again in a few moments.
verify.title: Verify certificate authenticity
verify.unreachable: Could not connect to the system; please try again in a few moments.
